text:
daniela: Heads up — hit a weird redwoodctl behavior on Windows 11 WSL2. After installing via MSI the CLI seems to pick the wrong profile when running `redwoodctl local test` from a repo dir with a `.redwood/config` file.
owen: which CLI version? MSI tends to install to Program Files which sometimes breaks XDG defaults.
daniela: redwoodctl v0.10.0 (installer from releases page). I have a `C:\Users\daniela\.config\redwoodctl\profiles.json` and also a local `.redwood/config` in my project with `profile: dev-daniela`. `redwoodctl auth login` works and `redwoodctl profiles list` shows `dev-daniela` active. But `redwoodctl local test` complains: `error: missing credentials for profile default`.
sasha: can you run with `REDWOODCTL_DEBUG=1` and paste logs? sometimes the local subcommand prefers a `REDWOOD_HOME` or vendor config in `cwd/.redwood` over XDG.
daniela: logs show: `loading config from C:\projects\myapp\.redwood\config -> profile: default` then `lookup profile default -> not found`.
owen: ah — installer sets `REDWOODCTL_HOME=C:\ProgramData\redwood` for service-mode installs. CLI priority order should be: env override, cwd `.redwood`, XDG config, program config. Looks like ours is reversed in 0.10.0 for `local` commands.
sasha: repro steps? I can try locally on wsl.
daniela: repro: 1) install MSI 2) create project with `.redwood/config` containing `profile: dev-daniela` 3) run `redwoodctl local test` from project dir -> fails. If I `export REDWOODCTL_CONFIG=%USERPROFILE%\.config\redwoodctl\profiles.json` and rerun it works.
owen: sounds like bug in cwd config parsing path on Windows (path separators maybe normalized wrong). Could also be precedence bug where global config takes priority and has empty default.
sasha: filing an issue: "local: config precedence broken on Windows MSI (cwd .redwood ignored)" assigned to @eng-tooling; labels: bug, windows, local-cli, high-prio.
diag: quick workaround for devs: set `REDWOODCTL_ACTIVE_PROFILE=dev-daniela` in your environment or add a `redwood.yaml` at repo root with `redwoodctl_profile: dev-daniela`. Also `redwoodctl config set active-profile dev-daniela` updates XDG file and works around.
daniela: thanks — setting `REDWOODCTL_ACTIVE_PROFILE` fixed it for now. I'll try WSL2 native binary later.
owen: assigning to eng-tooling to patch precedence logic. We should add an integration test on Windows and WSL for config precedence and add docs for env fallbacks.
sasha: note for release notes: call out MSI vs brew vs apt differences and mention `REDWOODCTL_*` env vars. Also add a small troubleshooting snippet: `REDWOODCTL_DEBUG=1 redwoodctl local test` -> will print which config file was picked.
ci-bot: Created issue #4821: "local: config precedence broken on Windows MSI (cwd .redwood ignored)" assigned to @eng-tooling; labels: bug, windows, local-cli, high-prio.
daniela: great, thanks. leaving this here in case others hit it. will post the msiexec log if needed. :pray:
